prompt: A JProgressBar and a status label report download progress. Complete setDownloaded so it clamps the value into 0..200 before storing it, and refresh so the bar and the label both show the percentage.
explanation: Clamping happens in the model method, not in the widget, so the stored number is always sensible even though JProgressBar would silently clip an out-of-range value on its own. Keeping the percentage calculation in one place (getPercent) means the bar and the label can never disagree. Integer division would throw the percentage away, so getPercent multiplies by 100.0 and rounds, which is why 1 of 200 units shows as 1 percent rather than 0.
hints: Clamp with two ifs: below 0 becomes 0, above TOTAL_UNITS becomes TOTAL_UNITS, otherwise keep the value.
Do not forget to call refresh() at the end of setDownloaded, or the display will lag behind the model.
refresh needs exactly two statements: bar.setValue(getPercent()) and status.setText(...) built from getPercent() and TOTAL_UNITS.
